Dino's Offline Adventure.name: Dino's Offline Adventure
Dino's Offline Adventure.summary: Dino's Offline Adventure is an endless runner homebrew for the Game Boy in the veins of the Chrome Dino game.

Hitori de Dekirumon! - Cooking Densetsu.name: Hitori de Dekirumon! Cooking Densetsu
Hitori de Dekirumon! - Cooking Densetsu.summary: A popular program on NHK Educational TV has become an RPG. Like the show, Mai-chan, the main character, will challenge the RPG. The battle scene with the enemy is in a quiz format.

Uchuu no Kishi Tekkaman Blade.name: Tekkaman Blade
Uchuu no Kishi Tekkaman Blade.summary: Tekkaman Blade is a 2D side-scrolling platform game where the player controls a mech and must find the exit to each level. The mech only has one melee weapon, but it can also use a special grappling hook, like in Ninja Gaiden Shadow, which is necessary to go through the levels. After the platforming part of the levels, the mech fights against a boss.
